generation_prompt: Create a SINGLE full-body neutral modelling reference of the EXACT same TABI character in the two supplied references. Reference 1 is the identity/design sheet; reference 2 is a clear full-body example of the same established character, not a new design. Preserve the large round pale lavender-pink axolotl head, small dark brown eyes, small simple smile, yellow forehead star and yellow freckles, symmetrical three pink branching gill stalks on EACH side with their delicate feathery branches, pink headphones with darker purple ear cushions, short cute body, pale pink hands and feet, long green coat with gold/leopard patterned collar cuffs and hem, dark buttons, and broad pink tail. Match the identity, proportions, colors and soft illustrated texture faithfully. Pose: exactly front facing, symmetrical relaxed A-pose, arms angled 30 degrees away from the body, both palms relaxed facing inward, both short legs straight and feet visibly separated shoulder-width; no walking stride. The head and neck must be naturally connected to the torso under the collar. One pair of arms only. Keep a clean small gap between hands and coat, and clear gaps between legs; preserve the coat shape, do not turn it into a bodysuit. Tail may be visible to one side behind the lower body. Whole silhouette including all gill tips, headphones, hands, feet and tail fully inside image with 10% margin. No table, cup, train, scenery, text, layout, shadow plane, multiple views, props, new accessories, or extra anatomy. Transparent background with genuine alpha, no checkerboard baked into pixels. This is a draft source for a 3D feasibility test, not an approved replacement character.
